verses.text: The earth is Jehovah’s, and the fulness thereof; The world, and they that dwell therein.

segments.text: The earth is Jehovah’s, and the fulness thereof;
The world, and they that dwell therein.

verses.text: For he hath founded it upon the seas, And established it upon the floods.

segments.text: For he hath founded it upon the seas,
And established it upon the floods.

verses.text: Who shall ascend into the hill of Jehovah? And who shall stand in his holy place?

segments.text: Who shall ascend into the hill of Jehovah?
And who shall stand in his holy place?

verses.text: He that hath clean hands, and a pure heart; Who hath not lifted up his soul unto falsehood, And hath not sworn deceitfully.

segments.text: He that hath clean hands, and a pure heart;
Who hath not lifted up his soul unto falsehood,
And hath not sworn deceitfully.

verses.text: He shall receive a blessing from Jehovah, And righteousness from the God of his salvation.

segments.text: He shall receive a blessing from Jehovah,
And righteousness from the God of his salvation.

verses.text: This is the generation of them that seek after him, That seek thy face, even Jacob. [Selah

segments.text: This is the generation of them that seek after him,
That seek thy face,
even
Jacob. [Selah

verses.text: Lift up your heads, O ye gates; And be ye lifted up, ye everlasting doors: And the King of glory will come in.

segments.text: Lift up your heads, O ye gates;
And be ye lifted up, ye everlasting doors:
And the King of glory will come in.

verses.text: Who is the King of glory? Jehovah strong and mighty, Jehovah mighty in battle.

segments.text: Who is the King of glory?
Jehovah strong and mighty,
Jehovah mighty in battle.

verses.text: Lift up your heads, O ye gates; Yea, lift them up, ye everlasting doors: And the King of glory will come in.

segments.text: Lift up your heads, O ye gates;
Yea, lift them up, ye everlasting doors:
And the King of glory will come in.

verses.text: Who is this King of glory? Jehovah of hosts, He is the King of glory. [Selah

segments.text: Who is this King of glory?
Jehovah of hosts,
He is the King of glory. [Selah
